verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Plaid supports webhook-based updates (plaid-docs-8, plaid-docs-4) and an API-driven `transactionsSync` call (plaid-gh-1, plaid-gh-2) that developers can invoke to pull current data, which is adjacent to an on-demand refresh trigger, but the pack never cites Plaid's dedicated refresh endpoint (e.g. /transactions/refresh) or documents its specific semantics (timing, cost, which products support it). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a refresh-on-demand endpoint and its semantics, confirmation of which products it applies to, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of its behavior.
